Builder Garage is an open-source, project-embedded framework of skills, roles, contracts, and evidence-based workflows for responsible software construction.

Get startedBrowse the Library

install from source
git clone https://github.com/bdonaldharris/builder-garage
cd builder-garage
go build ./cmd/garage
./garage --help

01 — HOW WORK MOVES

Engineering stays in the loop.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Understand the system before changing it.

  2. 02

    Assess readiness

    Resolve material uncertainty deliberately.

  3. 03

    Implement

    Keep work scoped to the evidence.

  4. 04

    Inspect

    Independent review tests the real artifact.

  5. 05

    Ship

    Human authority remains with the maintainer.

03 — LIBRARY

Parts you can inspect.

CLI

garage

A source-built CLI for project configuration, local workflow records, installed skills, and read-only GitHub workflow status.

View details →
SKILL implementer

application-implementation-workflow

Govern the application implementation lifecycle with scoped Agent #1 implementation, independent Agent #2 review, coherent issue-bound corrections, issue-recorded Agent #2 implementation review as the authoritative review record, a supplemental role-based Agent #2 PR review only when its triggers apply, optional automated review input, Agent #2-owned correction approval, and boring promotion.

View details →
SKILL discovery

engineering-discovery-workflow

Investigate an existing software system before implementation.

View details →
SKILL readiness

implementation-readiness-workflow

Determine whether a defined application change is sufficiently understood to implement responsibly.

View details →
SKILL reviewer

independent-implementation-review

Perform the independent Agent #2 review of an implementation artifact using the narrow three-question review contract: acceptance criteria met, no new bug/regression introduced, and implemented behavior works.
